mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past quarter signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than a 5-year rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) during the easing period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in monthly job openings (PAYEMS) over the past year indicates strengthening labor market demand, amplifying corporate investment and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to outperform a 10-year rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) during the labor expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.6% triggers a positive labor market signal, reducing uncertainty and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) despite the UNRATE crossing below 4.6% in the trigger period.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand-side GDP (GDPC1) and supply-side production (INDPRO) creates a virtuous cycle of economic expansion, enhancing corporate profits and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the combined GDPC1-INDPRO growth index (R-squared < 0.3) during the expansion phase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not show significant negative deviation from a pre-tightening period baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, strong labor market conditions (rising job openings and falling unemployment) signal sustained growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to outperform a 5-year rolling average during the late-cycle expansion period (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the production index (INDPRO) over the past quarter reflects robust supply-side growth, boosting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns do not significantly exceed a 10-year rolling average (t-test p > 0.05) during the supply-side expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in the federal funds rate and growth in demand-side GDP (GDPC1) create a favorable dual signal for equity markets, lowering discount rates and amplifying corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to correlate with the combined FEDFUNDS-GDPC1 growth index (R-squared < 0.25) during the easing period.
